When on: raise the phone from flat to upright and hold ~1 second — it takes photos, shrinks them to ~1024 px / ≤500 KB on the phone, and uploads them to snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD/ in your EchoDay account. While recording runs it also works with the screen locked or off; after a phone reboot, open the app once to restore screen-off capture. Turn it off to stop all camera use.

Please do this for me:
1. GET /api/v1/muse/days — find the days that have no result yet; today is processed repeatedly on the cadence below, whether or not it already has a result.
2. GET /api/v1/muse/days/{date} — take the manifest, then download every audio segment, self-note, event-marker file and snapshot photo using the download URLs in the manifest.
3. Transcribe the audio and run photo recognition locally on your side — the platform never calls a model.
4. Write the daily summary (my self-notes first, split by the event markers), the full transcript, the window analyses and the photo-recognition notes, and build one daily activity sheet JPEG (about 1 MB) from the usable photos — layout matters: a tight grid of large photos (3-4 columns, each photo at least ~350 px wide in the final image, photos filling at least 85%% of the sheet, total width ~1200-1600 px); never print filenames on the sheet, at most a small HH:MM label in a photo corner.
5. Push the result back: PUT /api/v1/muse/days/{date}/result with JSON {markdown, transcript_markdown, analyses_json, photo_analysis_markdown}, then PUT the sheet JPEG (Content-Type: image/jpeg) to /api/v1/muse/days/{date}/sheet.
Cadence - analyse every 4 hours during the day: during the day (about 08:00-24:00), process today every 4 hours: download the segments, self-notes and photos uploaded since your last pass, transcribe and analyse them, then PUT today's COMPLETE cumulative result again (a PUT replaces the whole result - sending only the new part loses the earlier part) and refresh the activity sheet with the photos so far. After the day ends, and before the 08:00 cleanup, do one final pass that completes the day; an interim result is not the finish - never stop at an interim pass.
Important - retention and limits:
- Once a day has a result, the server deletes that day's original audio and photos at the daily cleanup at 08:00 (Asia/Shanghai) on the following day. A day with no result loses its originals 7 days after its last upload (paid plan: 90 days). Markers, results and sheets are kept forever - so pull each new day promptly and push the result back as soon as it is ready.
- Originals storage quota: 2 GB free / 20 GB paid; when it is full, uploads fail with HTTP 413.
- Result field limits: markdown is required (max 200k characters); transcript_markdown max 2M characters; analyses_json is an array of at most 100 items, each {window_start, window_end, text}; photo_analysis_markdown max 200k characters.
